table_of_contents.title: Since Somer MacDonald's humiliating encounter with Chase Lorimer on the isle of Jersey, she had kept men at a distance.
Five years ago she had foolishly tried to prove her sexual desirability by seducing the gorgeous world-renowned photographer. But her plan had backfired when Chase coldly denied her advances.
Now Chase was suddenly back in her life--and he wanted to marry her! The all-encompassing force drawing Somer to him was undeniable. But could she risk rejection again?

description.value:
Marry Chase Lorimer--impossible!

Since Somer MacDonald's humiliating encounter with Chase Lorimer on the isle of Jersey, she had kept men at a distance.

Five years ago she had foolishly tried to prove her sexual desirability by seducing the gorgeous world-renowned photographer. But her plan had backfired when Chase coldly denied her advances.

Now Chase was suddenly back in her life--and he wanted to marry her! The all-encompassing force drawing Somer to him was undeniable. But could she risk rejection again?
